stories.headline: AIIB agrees $1.6 billion climate-policy financing package with Türkiye
stories.summary: Reuters reported on 12 November that the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank agreed a $1.6 billion financing package to support Türkiye's climate-policy reforms, clean-energy investment and resilience. This is a financing commitment, not evidence that all funds have been disbursed.

stories.headline: Two sisters of former prime minister Imran Khan released from detention
stories.summary: Reuters reported on 12 November that Uzma Khan and Noreen Niazi were released from Kot Lakhpat Jail in Lahore after their detention orders were suspended. The report attributed confirmation to their lawyer; the suspension of detention orders is not equivalent to an acquittal.

stories.headline: Taiwan names Stan Shih envoy to upcoming APEC leaders' summit in Shenzhen
stories.summary: Reuters reported on 12 November that Taiwan's president said its delegation would participate in the forthcoming APEC summit in Shenzhen and that Acer founder Stan Shih would represent Taiwan. The summit had not yet taken place.
